# `aitbc dispute arbitrator authorize`

Grant or revoke arbitrator rights for an address (admin only).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc dispute arbitrator authorize [OPTIONS] ARBITRATOR_ADDRESS
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `arbitrator_address` | text | yes | — |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--revoke` | flag | `false` | no | Revoke authorization instead of granting it. |
| `--signature` | text | — | no | Owner signature authorising the change; required by nodes that enforce it. |
| `--node-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain node RPC URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc dispute arbitrator authorize ARBITRATOR_ADDRESS
```
